dct_description_sm: 2015-2021 editions of the data. Mexico data is included in the 2019 edition and onwards. Lithuania data is included in the 2020 edition and onwards.

This dataset comprises statistics on coal supply forecasts for IEA countries while focusing on the flow those coal products (hard coal, brown coal, anthracite, coking coal, bituminous coal, lignite). Data projections extend to 2030. [Data editions 2015-2021].
